response.sql: WITH fund_project_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.arcref) as cnt FROM scanspatial sp INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), stats AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL)) as avg_count FROM fund_project_counts) SELECT fpc.fundflux, fpc.cnt as count, CAST(fpc.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_count as share, fpc.cnt - s.avg_count as exceeds_average FROM fund_project_counts fpc CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE fpc.cnt > s.avg_count
